title: deathframe
summary: MSUI implements the current Benilla death arc through a dedicated DeathFrame law: release/no-timer, corpse recovery and in-instance notice, strict sickness/timer resurrect variants, two-stage alert-width spirit-healer confirmation, exact countdown/range/Escape behavior, death durability warning, own-corpse tracking, and POIIcons corpse markers on the world map and in-range minimap.

openItems.text: No Release Spirit dialog - RequestRepop is only reachable through the live-run dev protocol ('repop' command in Program.LiveRun.cs); a dead player has no UI button to release, and no release countdown text
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the DEATH popup exposes Release Spirit with the exact 360-second/no-timer text, and all geometry is owned by DeathFrameUiLaw.

openItems.text: No spirit-healer CONFIRM_XP_LOSS confirmation dialog (25% durability / resurrection sickness texts) - SpiritHealerActivate exists on the wire but no UI asks first
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: SMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_CONFIRM opens the 420px alert popup, first Accept rewrites the second ask without wire, and only the second Accept activates the healer.

openItems.text: Resurrect-request text lacks the reference sickness variants ('...You will be afflicted with resurrection sickness')
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict sickness and reclaim-timer flags select RESURRECT, RESURRECT_NO_SICKNESS, and RESURRECT_NO_TIMER wording and gates.
2026-08-21: the corpse-query display/corpse map split raises the buttonless in-instance notice inside the exact 40-yard gate.
